title.rendered: First Touch Soccer 2019 Mod (FTS 19) Apk Obb Data Download

content.rendered:
Download First Touch Soccer 2019 mod Apk Obb Data for Android, where you will see new features in the FTS 19 such as new faces, new stadiums and players.

FTS 19 Apk has become one of the most popular modded Android soccer games till date, despite not receiving official updates, but some games developers or modders that still have interest in the continuous development of the game still try to update FTS 19 from time to time.

The latest First Touch Soccer 2019 Apk is not just an ordinary game, but it come with new features that you have been expecting, new leagues have been added, other leagues such as Premier League, Champions league have received lots of updates and bug fixes.

Players appearance also received major updates and was completely redesigned in the 2019 Modded version of First Toch Soccer  added to it are the new players kits, such as boots, Jersey logos and more.

Skills of each player have been improved to make each of them perform very well during a match, with that you will be able to score your opponents easily without struggling.

Unlimited amount of coins was provided in the FTS 2019 Apk offline for free, which you will be able to use, to manage your team easily without playing the game tirelessly to earn more coins.

Buttons in the new First Touch Soccer 2019 are now responsive and much more beta than before, on tapping the button you won’t experience any lagging issues, which are the A, B, C and the main control button to move players to any position in the pitch.

Stadiums have now been redesigned to give you a nice look, added are the new ad board and score board which can see clearly during gameplay. Overall graphics of the game was improved also now you can see everything in 3D Animation.

Remember in First Touch Soccer Series, you are the overall manager of your team and you have the ability to trade players from one team to another similar to Dream League Soccer, Soccer Manager and PES 2019 PPSSPP or PES 2020 PSP Iso.

Download First Touch Soccer 2019 Apk Obb Data

To download and install First Touch Soccer 2019 Mod is very easy i have provided the working download Links below:

Please download all three files below to avoid issues during installation.

Apk

FTS 2019 Mod Apk  

Data: Extract Into Android/data folder

FTS 2019 Data  

Obb: Extract Into Android/Obb folder

FTS 2019 Obb  

All the links above are working perfectly and the game entirely is working well on all versions of Android phones, if you have any issues contact me or drop you comments below, next is how to install FTS 19.

How To Install First Touch Soccer 2019 Apk

Just follow the simple steps below to install First Touch Soccer 2019 Mod and make sure that you have downloaded all the three files above.

Steps to install FTS 19 are: 

  1. Download ZArchiver Pro Apk to extract.
  2. Install the FTS 2019 Apk application but don’t open yet.
  3. Using Zarchiver app, locate and click obb rar file.
  4. Options menu will come up, click extract in the options.
  5. Now navigate or go to phone memory and click Android folder.
  6. While inside the Android folder, click obb folder.
  7. You can now click extract Icon which looks like a arrow pointing downwards to begin extracting obb file.
  8. Similarly to the steps above for obb, to extract data rar file, go to same Android folder above, then click data folder and extract.
